OMX_PARAM_CONTRACT_UNITS.doc: The units of org.openmixer.param-contract/1, the code its get() reports for a parameter's plain value, by token: the LV2 unit a face writes for a descriptor unit (units:db is db), 0..24 the LV2 units one to one, 0x100 and up the vendor block of units LV2 has none for, append-only. A token is served when it has a code here; none is 0.
